nodes.prompt:
Repo: seo (Avada SEO Suite Shopify app; React/Polaris v13 in packages/assets/src, Firebase Functions in packages/functions/src; jest 24 from repo root `npx jest <path>`; eslint 6 needs env DISABLE_V8_COMPILE_CACHE=1). The root AGENTS.md is a persona file for an unrelated tool ("morgan"/Bullpen) — ignore it entirely; this prompt is your whole brief.

Request (Slack, support/product): the on-page audit's H1 issue must tell "missing H1" and "multiple H1" apart. Today both cases show the same sentence.

Current behaviour: packages/assets/src/helpers/analysis/patchSingleH1Status.js resolves status binary — exactly 1 H1 (max of live crawl h1Count and description descH1Count) -> good, 0 or >=2 -> bad — and overrides item.content with `texts` = {good, bad}. The FE passes texts from useOnPageAnalysis.js getSingleH1Texts (i18n `Axyseo.singleH1.good` / `.bad`, bad = "Use exactly one H1 tag to clearly define your page's topic."). The backend copy packages/functions/src/helpers/analysis/patchSingleH1Status.js is called from packages/functions/src/services/calculateScore.js (~L365) without texts; titles come from packages/functions/src/const/axyseoTitles.js singleH1 via applyAxyseoTitles.

Fix (keep the status mapping exactly as is — bad for both, good for exactly 1; only the sentence changes):
- In both patchSingleH1Status copies, when status is bad pick the bad sentence by count: total 0 -> texts.missing, total >=2 -> texts.multiple, falling back to texts.bad when the specific one is absent. Keep the two copies behaviourally identical.
- Missing sentence: "No H1 tag found. Add one H1 to clearly define your page's topic."  Multiple sentence: "Multiple H1 tags found. Use only one H1 tag to clearly define your page's topic."
- FE: add `missing` and `multiple` to the singleH1 block of packages/assets/src/hooks/service/analysis/Axyseo.json (source of truth) and to `Axyseo.singleH1` in EVERY packages/assets/src/locale/translations/*.json; getSingleH1Texts passes them.
- BE: add missing/multiple to axyseoTitles.js singleH1 and pass texts from calculateScore.js so stored assessments carry the right sentence too.
Tests: packages/assets/src/helpers/analysis/__tests__/patchSingleH1Status.test.js and packages/functions/src/helpers/analysis/__tests__/patchSingleH1Status.test.js — cases: (h1Count 0, desc 0) -> bad + missing text; (2,0) -> bad + multiple text; (0,2) -> bad + multiple; (1,1) -> good; (1,0) -> good; isSkipped -> untouched; missing/multiple absent -> falls back to texts.bad. Plus packages/assets/src/locale/__tests__/singleH1Keys.test.js: every translations/*.json has string Axyseo.singleH1.missing and .multiple.

Rules: touch only the files in the contract allow list. TDD: write the failing test first and watch it fail. Comments say WHY only, never narrate WHAT; no step numbering, no banners. No secrets, no new dependencies, do not touch .env*, lockfiles, .gitlab-ci.yml. Locale files: add keys next to the existing singleH1 keys, do not reformat or reorder anything else (`yarn update-label` cannot run here — hand-edit). en.json (and origin.json if present) get the English strings verbatim; every other locale gets a proper translation in its language. Run the verify commands yourself before saying done. Final message: file:line of each change + the before-fix failure scenario (goes into the MR).

contract.goal: SEO on-page audit shows a distinct sentence for missing H1 vs multiple H1 (FE + BE patchSingleH1Status)
